world: SEMVM_END_TO_END_POC_V1 world model + STATUS attribute (OPEN|CLOSED, absent=OPEN) on events

semantics.FIND: active events of TYPE in creation order satisfying every [SCOPE.REL=VALUE] (SELF / PARENT via TODO / CHILD via TODO) and optional STATUS
semantics.FIND_LAST: most recently created active event of TYPE; none -> NOT_FOUND
semantics.GET: the active REL value of an EVENT (PERSON or scalar) or NONE
semantics.FIRST: first EVENT of a list or NONE
semantics.COUNT: INT length of an EVENT_LIST / VALUE_LIST
semantics.SELECT: VALUE_LIST of the REL values (NONE skipped)
semantics.SORT: list sorted by the rendered REL value (NONE last), ties by creation order
semantics.GROUP: GROUPS keyed by the rendered REL value (NONE key null), keys sorted
semantics.REPORT: REPORT rows [key, count, sorted distinct rendered REL values] from GROUPS (structured REPORT value; Amendment 001)
semantics.UPDATE: retract active (EVENT, REL, *), assert (EVENT, REL, VALUE); REL must be legal for the event type (frozen matrix); a new PERSON surface is created with its alias
semantics.DELETE: object deleted, all its active relations retracted
semantics.FOR: bounded iteration over an EVENT_LIST (<= 100 items)
semantics.CALL: call an ACTIVE procedure (no recursion, DAG only)
semantics.RETURN: return a value; every procedure ends with RETURN

transaction: one invocation = one SQLite transaction (nested CALLs share it); world postconditions before commit; any error -> rollback
